query:
UPDATE core.contracts
         SET status = 'active',
             lease_period = tstzrange(now(), now() + interval '365 days'),
             drafted_at = now(),
             handed_to_tenant_at = now(),
             tenant_signed_at = now(),
             documents_received_at = now(),
             landlord_signed_at = now(),
             reg_number = $2,
             registered_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1
